error[L0315]: this argument is passed `inout`, so the call may change its storage while another argument of the same call still views it
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/view-argument-beside-its-source/main.ldn:48:20
   |
48 |     try append_all(numbers, memory, vec.used(numbers)) -- error
   |                    ^^^^^^^
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/view-argument-beside-its-source/main.ldn:48:37
   |
48 |     try append_all(numbers, memory, vec.used(numbers)) -- error
   |                                     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ the argument that views it
  = note: [0800]/[0830]: the `inout` parameter `target` locks its argument whether or not the routine writes it; copy what the other argument views into storage of its own before the call, or, if the routine only reads it, declare `target` without `inout`

error[L0315]: this argument is passed `inout`, so the call may change its storage while a view taken earlier in this expression is still in use
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/view-argument-beside-its-source/main.ldn:64:39
   |
64 |     n += sum2(part(addr q), reset_rec(q)) -- error
   |                                       ^
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/view-argument-beside-its-source/main.ldn:64:15
   |
64 |     n += sum2(part(addr q), reset_rec(q)) -- error
   |               ^^^^^^^^^^^^ the view taken before the call
  = note: [0800]/[0830]: the `inout` parameter `r` locks its argument whether or not the routine writes it; make this call first, in a statement of its own, and take the view after it, or, if the routine only reads it, declare `r` without `inout`
